meta_data.base_class: Provide <medical advice> based on patient conditions - refers to various types of professional guidance related to medical rehabilitation.

patient_details.description: Detailed description of the patient conditions.

age_group.description: The general age category of the patient. One of: 'Child', 'Adolescent', 'Adult', 'Senior'.

urgency_level.description: Indicates the urgency level for the <class>, such as 'low', 'medium', or 'high'.

cultural_considerations.description: Any cultural considerations or restrictions applicable to the <class>.

delivery_method.description: Preferred method of delivering the <class>, such as 'in-person', 'video call', or 'written'.

practitioner_availability.description: Indicates whether a practitioner is available to implement the <class> immediately.
